description: MANCHESTER, VT — July 29, 2026 — Thomas West, Democratic candidate for Vermont House representing the Bennington-4 district, is proud to announce that his campaign has earned the endorsement of the Planned Parenthood Vermont Action Fund IE PAC (PPVTAF IE PAC) for the 2026 election.
